mapper.select: SELECT promotion_id AS promotionId, promotion_title AS promotionTitle, discount_type AS discountType, discount_value AS discountValue, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, image_path AS imagePath, status FROM promotion WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(start_date) AND TRUNC(end_date) ORDER BY promotion_id DESC

SELECT promotion_id, promotion_title, discount_type, discount_value, start_date, end_date, is_active AS isActive FROM promotion WHERE 1=1
AND promotion_title LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
ORDER BY promotion_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion WHERE 1 = 1
AND promotion_title LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion (promotion_id, promotion_title, discount_type, discount_value, start_date, end_date, is_active, status) VALUES (promotion_seq.NEXTVAL, #{promotionTitle}, #{discountType}, #{discountValue}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, 'Y', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE promotion SET promotion_title = #{promotionTitle}, discount_type = #{discountType}, discount_value = #{discountValue}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE promotion_id = #{promotionId}
UPDATE promotion SET is_active = 'N' WHERE promotion_id = #{promotionId}
UPDATE promotion SET is_active = 'D' WHERE promotion_id = #{promotionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE discount_rate > 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PP.PRODUCT_ID) FROM PROMOTION_PRODUCT PP /* PP테이블과 PR테이블을 PROMOTION_ID로 연결 */ JOIN PROMOTION PR ON PP.PROMOTION_ID = PR.PROMOTION_ID WHERE PR.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND UPPER(PR.IS_ACTIVE) = 'Y' /* 오라클 날짜 비교 최적화 */ AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(PR.START_DATE) AND TRUNC(PR.END_DATE)
